description: Immutable GamerQA review policy v1 covering Tier 0 static/security and Tier 1 runtime-web checks.

rules.title: Catalog & manifest ID parity
rules.description: Catalog entries must have unique valid IDs, matching paths, and matching game.manifest.json identity.

rules.title: Manifest contract validation
rules.description: game.manifest.json must satisfy required schemaVersion=1, localized metadata, capabilities, save, and media fields.

rules.title: Web entry HTML existence
rules.description: Declared entry HTML under Web/ must exist as a non-empty regular file.

rules.title: Path isolation & symlink prohibition
rules.description: Game folders and asset references must not use symlinks, parent traversal (..), backslashes, or absolute paths.

rules.title: Static local asset resolution
rules.description: Manifest media and HTML asset references must resolve inside Web/ to existing valid files.

rules.title: Forbidden HTML / packaging patterns
rules.description: Blocks <base>/<object>/<embed>/external <meta refresh>, warns on relative <meta refresh> or legacy ES module scripts.

rules.title: Bundle size & tree budget
rules.description: Web/ bundle must stay within entry count, per-file (100 MiB), and total (300 MiB) limits.

rules.title: Unallowlisted active external network references
rules.description: Blocks external script/stylesheet/img/iframe/fetch/XHR/WebSocket/sendBeacon URLs absent from capabilities.externalNetwork.

rules.title: Passive external URLs in metadata/links
rules.description: Inventories passive external reference/provenance URLs in inline data or anchor links when externalNetwork is empty.

rules.title: Dangerous dynamic code & injection APIs
rules.description: Blocks eval(), new Function(), document.write(), javascript: URIs, and script injection in game code; notes Emscripten runtime glue.

rules.title: Manifest capability consistency
rules.description: Verifies declared capabilities (wasm, webgl, workers) match files and runtime APIs found in Web/.

rules.title: Local static HTTP entry boot
rules.description: Entry HTML served from loopback static HTTP host must return HTTP 200 with HTML content.

rules.title: Local static HTTP asset responses
rules.description: All referenced HTML, script, stylesheet, media, and WASM/PCK assets must return HTTP 200.

rules.title: Headless browser load & render
rules.description: Browser must load the game entry, reach ready state, and mount visible DOM/canvas content.

rules.title: Zero console errors & uncaught exceptions
rules.description: Browser execution must record zero uncaught JS/WASM exceptions, console errors, or declared asset 4xx/5xx errors.

rules.title: Outbound network isolation
rules.description: Browser execution must make zero outbound requests to non-allowlisted external origins.

rules.title: Runtime screenshot capture
rules.description: Captures a non-empty PNG screenshot of the loaded game viewport as QA evidence.
